limitations.L1: endovascular implant configured for CSF drainage
limitations.L2: size-selective filtration element within the shunt lumen
limitations.L3: filtration element permits passage of CSF fluid
limitations.L4: filtration element retains molecule above size threshold
limitations.L5: CSF drainage maintained during therapeutic retention
limitations.L6: integrated into eShunt anatomy (dural venous sinus deployment)

claim_language_verbatim: An endovascularly implantable CSF shunt device comprising: a shunt body having opposed first and second ends, the first end configured for deployment in a subarachnoid space and the second end configured for deployment in a dural venous sinus; a size-selective filtration element disposed within a lumen of the shunt body between the first and second ends, the filtration element permitting passage of cerebrospinal fluid while retaining a therapeutic agent above a size threshold; wherein CSF drainage is maintained during therapeutic agent retention.
